name: Doting Feisty Mrs. Qin
overview: Nurse Jiang Xiaohe, who died from overwork during a night shift, suddenly woke up as the top wealthy wife in Shangjing! Just as she soul-swapped, she encountered a battlefield of emotions, being called a "homewrecker" by the original host's toxic best friend, who threatened to kill her along with another man. But the original host's husband, Qin She, was wealthy, handsome, and heirless. To ensure a worry-free life, Jiang Xiaohe decisively abandoned the toxic script and transformed into an ultra-sweet and clingy wife, charming her golden, heirless husband in every way possible. Little did she know, the once cold and misogynistic man would become a doting husband, spoiling her beyond imagination.
